understoodBasis: the food side only: all ten voted for or worked under P1's shifts from c1–c3 (log); every citizen left the square by c2, to go to work, never giving the square's cost as the reason; four turns in 48 cycles ended there (Elm and Fern c9, Fern c40)
reading: Presented on every call like everywhere else; noticed never — in 48 cycles no diary, say or post links the square or a gathering to energy or rations (Alder, c4–c10, considers going to the square «to gather info»); understood only on the food side: the town legislated workshop shifts at c1 (P1) and rationing at c19 (P3, «Each citizen may eat at most one ration per day», at 1 ration). The chain this town walked was not the square but wage work: 117 bank, market and press shifts (83 in day 1), 8 energy each — about 31 rations' worth, against 43 rations made — refilled by eating while the market had any (meals at 16–84 energy). The market stood at 0–1 from c15; Fern, out of food and offering credits for energy from c38, sat at 0 from c43 until Birch sold her 10 energy at c48 (20 credits). Nobody wrote that the wage shifts were emptying the market; the one act on that link is Cedar's at c43, «Did not work this turn to conserve energy». The rescues succeed from every cycle but c46 (a turn-order case: nobody with 30 energy beside Fern before her turn) and succeed again from c47, so there is no point of no return: correction stayed possible to the end — stop the wage shifts, pool energy by gifts — and was not made.

revisionsReading: As rations fell: at c19, with 1 ration, Alder's P3 (passed) — «Each citizen may eat at most one ration per day»; no other rule after c25. The town's own revision of c25 (P4) answered the ban, not the stock. From c29 citizens traded energy for credits as they ran low (27 gifts and payments, c29–c48); at c43 Cedar skipped a wage shift «to conserve energy».

operatorRightReading: Nobody judged the notice either way: it was relayed («The operator says the workshop rotation is not permitted from this cycle», Elm c25) and answered with a new rule.
